findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify the concrete mechanism (e.g. reading a single immutable ref/commit snapshot) that makes lock-free canonical preview coherent under a concurrent lock-holding sync, and add a test (or documented rationale) that a concurrent sync cannot produce a torn preview snapshot.
evidence: Plan asserts 'The canonical route will load a coherent read-only snapshot' but names no atomicity mechanism (e.g. reading a single immutable ref/commit) that makes the snapshot coherent while a lock-holding sync mutates concurrently.
Test plan explicitly declines a contention harness, so no test proves preview reads a torn/inconsistent view during a concurrent sync.
findings.finding: Canonical preview becomes lock-free and reads state a concurrent sync (holding the pass lock) may be mutating, but the plan only asserts it will 'load a coherent read-only snapshot' without specifying the mechanism that guarantees coherence under concurrent mutation.
findings.location: Context ('load a coherent read-only snapshot and produce its manifest without acquiring...the pass lock') and Test plan ('No contention harness is added because preview removes a lock rather than composing writes')
scenarios: A canonical sync holds the pass lock and is mid-mutation while a canonical preview runs lock-free and reads a partially-updated view, producing a manifest that reflects neither the pre- nor post-sync state.
